connect-client-dialog.tokenIssuedBody: The copy buttons now include its full Authorization header.
connect-client-dialog.title: Client snippets
connect-client-dialog.aboutTooltip: Give this MCP gateway configuration to your tool. It does not give it access to Myrmidon or skills; it only gateways calls between the client and the tools exposed here.
connect-client-dialog.description: Choose a client and copy a complete, authenticated configuration.
connect-client-dialog.issueHint: Issue a token before copying a snippet; the full <0>Authorization: Bearer …</0> header is required. Existing token secrets cannot be retrieved again, so only tokens issued in this page session can fill a snippet.
connect-client-dialog.noSnippets: No client snippets available for this gateway.
connect-client-dialog.tokenWarning: Treat the token like a password. Anyone holding it can call the tools this gateway allows. Revoke it if it leaks.

edit-gateway-dialog.title: Edit gateway
edit-gateway-dialog.description: Change the label or the access profile that controls which tools this endpoint exposes.
edit-gateway-dialog.name: Name

gateway-detail.offBody: {{name}} is off — every client goes silent.
gateway-detail.selectOrganization: Select an organization to manage gateways.

new-gateway-dialog.title: New gateway
new-gateway-dialog.description: One safe MCP endpoint that exposes only the apps in its access profile. Hand it to a client like Cursor or Claude Desktop.
new-gateway-dialog.name: Name
new-gateway-dialog.profileHint: The profile decides which tools this gateway allows. You can change it later.
new-gateway-dialog.descriptionPlaceholder: Who this endpoint is for and when it should be rotated.
new-gateway-dialog.noProfiles: Create an access profile under Advanced before adding a gateway.

apps-tools-panel.intro: These apps go through this gateway. The bound profile decides which tools are allowed. Change the profile under Advanced.
apps-tools-panel.introWithProfile: These apps go through this gateway. The bound profile ({{name}}) decides which tools are allowed — {{allowed}}. Change the profile under Advanced.
apps-tools-panel.empty: No apps are assigned to this gateway’s profile yet.

gateways-list.offBody: {{name}} is off — every client goes silent.
gateways-list.selectOrganization: Select an organization to manage gateways.
gateways-list.title: Apps
gateways-list.intro: A gateway is one safe MCP endpoint that exposes only the apps you assign. Hand it to a client like Cursor or Claude Desktop.
gateways-list.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, app, or owner
gateways-list.whyBody: You pick which apps go through it, who can use it, and how. Revoke the token, the whole gateway goes silent — no app-by-app cleanup.

empty.title: No gateways yet
empty.body: Group your connected apps into one safe endpoint you can hand to a client, then revoke it in one move.
